title: 5 Steam Black Friday Deals Under $1 an Hour
caption:
Black Friday week on Steam, ranked by what an hour costs you: Dark Souls 3 96¢, Baldur's Gate 3 58¢, Skyrim 47¢, Red Dead 2 30¢, Hades 26¢. Sale price ÷ HowLongToBeat main-story hours, our own math. These are publisher deals on Steam (most end 30 Nov-7 Dec), not a storewide Steam sale.
Which deal are you grabbing? Comment a game and we price it next.

Sources: Steam store (US prices, 25 Nov), HowLongToBeat
ig_first_line: Send this to the friend with $20 to spend this weekend: Hades is 26¢ an hour on Steam right now.
